bio: The charm of this Ardennes house is encapsulated by the landscaped garden, providing the perfect foil to the warm, inviting interior. Ingredients take the star role in gutsy nostalgic recipes, albeit with a scattering of refreshing creative twists. For example, the chef’s perfectly cooked veal in truffles with Asian flavours. The menu with options is a model of full-bodied generosity. Deliciously eater friendly prices!...
